column1: # SPI service-file overrides applied at binary-stamp time by
# singlejar concatenates each dependency jar's META-INF/services file in
# dependency-topological order (deps before dependents), and the JDK/Lucene SPI
# loaders are first-wins, so a third-party entry (e.g. lucene-core) can shadow a
# mongot @AutoService override that registers the SAME SPI name. For each row
# below, the stamp step verifies BOTH the source and target entries are present
# in the named service file -- failing the build loudly otherwise -- then strips
# the source entry so the target format becomes the sole provider of that SPI
# name. The target reads source-written segments unchanged (identical on-disk
# layout); it just wins forName() resolution on the read path.
# Lines beginning with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
